en.text: Private & Public Goods

zh.text: 私用品及共用品

en.text: Which of the following statements about a public good is correct?

zh.text: 下列哪一項關於共用品的陳述是正確的？

en.text: A public toilet (water closet) is an example of a public good.

zh.text: 公廁是共用品的一個例子。

en.text: When the marginal cost of serving a good to an extra consumer is zero, that good is a public good.

zh.text: 當向額外一名消費者提供某物品的邊際成本為零時，該物品便是共用品。

en.text: A public good is characterized by the fact that one person's use of the good does not reduce the amount available for himself in the future.

zh.text: 共用品的特徵是，某人使用該物品並不會減少自己將來可獲得的數量。

en.text: None of the above.

zh.text: 以上皆不是。

en.text: HKALE 1999 Paper 1 Q21

zh.text: 香港高級程度會考 1999 卷一 第 21 題

en.text: A public good is

zh.text: 共用品是指

en.text: a good provided by the government but a price is charged.

zh.text: 由政府提供但收取價格的物品。

en.text: a good that must be produced by the government because it is too costly for a private producer to sell and collect payments.

zh.text: 必須由政府生產的物品，因為私人產銷及收費的成本過高。

en.text: a good that can be consumed by many individuals at the same time.

zh.text: 可供許多人同時消費的物品。

en.text: a good that may be used by the public free of charge.

zh.text: 可供公眾免費使用的物品。

en.text: Which of the following statements about public goods is correct?

zh.text: 下列哪一項關於共用品的陳述是正確的？

en.text: A public good is a good provided free-of-charge by the government.

zh.text: 共用品是由政府免費提供的物品。

en.text: A public good is a good that can be consumed concurrently by a large number of users.

zh.text: 共用品是可供大量使用者同時消費的物品。

en.text: There is no competition in the production of public goods.

zh.text: 共用品的生產沒有競爭。

en.text: A public good is a good that is not scarce.

zh.text: 共用品並非稀少性物品。

en.text: A parking lot in the government headquarters is reserved for government officials. The parking lot is ______ because ______.

zh.text: 政府總部的某車位是預留給各政府官員使用的。這個車位屬 ________，因爲 ________。

en.text: a private good ... it is for private use only

zh.text: 私用品 ... 它只作私人用途

en.text: a private good ... concurrent consumption is not possible

zh.text: 私用品 ... 它不可能被同時共享

en.text: a public good ... the government owns it

zh.text: 共用品 ... 政府擁有它

en.text: a public good ... no one has an exclusive right to use

zh.text: 共用品 ... 沒有人享有其獨有使用權

en.text: A public good

zh.text: 共用品

en.text: is a good with zero marginal cost of production.

zh.text: 是一種邊際生產成本為零的物品。

en.text: can only be provided by the government.

zh.text: 只可以由政府提供。

en.text: cannot be protected by private property rights.

zh.text: 不能以私有產權保護。

en.text: allows concurrent consumption by many individuals.

zh.text: 容許多人同時使用。

en.text: HKDSE 2017 Paper 1 Q3

en.text: In Lunar New Year, tourists reserve tables in waterfront restaurants to enjoy firework display. The firework display is a
because

zh.text: 農曆新年時，旅客在海濱餐廳訂座，觀賞煙花匯演。該煙花匯演是 ________，因為 ________。

en.text: public good ... the government pays for the firework display

zh.text: 共用品……政府支付該煙花匯演的費用

en.text: public good ... one individual’s consumption will not reduce its availability to others

zh.text: 共用品……某人享用該物品不會減少其他人可享用的數量

en.text: private good ... private firms have to use resources to produce the firework display

zh.text: 私用品……私人廠商須使用資源來生產該煙花匯演

en.text: private good ... the seats in waterfront restaurants are excludable in consumption

zh.text: 私用品……海濱餐廳座位的使用具排他性
